name: Move DynamoDB Data to Amazon Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **DynamoDB** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **Redshift** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Add DataBase details - Access Key, Secret Key and AWS Location to add Credentials
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/dynamo-db/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
